notes.title: Demo version 0.2.4.6
notes.notes:
A while back, it was pointed out that the hood of the main protagonist looks a bit like a clan member. This was never my intention, and any sort of resemblance, even vague, is not ideal. So, as a precaution, I made the choice to alter the headwear slightly—changing the face a bit, as well as making the hood slightly longer. This update changes the player's appearance slightly, while still remaining recognizable. 
[p align="start"]Personally, I like this new design more, as I feel it gives the player a bit more character. I hope you like the new look as well. I'll update the screenshots a bit later, as well as the GIFs on the store page. Unfortunately, the demo trailer will still retain the old hood design, at least for now.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Here's the list of the rest of the fixes and tweaks:

New hood design for the player

Skeletons and other bony enemies now have a different color, as they were accidentally green (I'm partially color blind and didn't notice until now)

A bunch of other graphical fixes and adjustments

Fixed main menu sub-weapon changing, as returning to the main menu from mid-game allowed the player to change sub-weapons

Cleaned up an old hidden beetroot from the challenge level
[p align="start"]The Deflector Grip  

Is now a bit more powerful, and works against the Wall Stalker's projectiles (the rapid-firing white skull enemy)

Deflecting enemy projectiles with this equipped now creates some extra sparkle effects



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694425/541b9808aefc2773d2958d10cbc8d57fb3dc42a9.png"]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2.4.5
notes.notes:
After gathering feedback and observing gameplay, I’ve added a new mechanic: the player can now use the whip and sub-weapons while climbing ladders. This means the player is no longer defenseless during ladder sequences. 

In addition, I made a few minor changes, such as in the ladder room in Challenge Level 1, where you now need to use this new ladder attack mechanic to activate the button. There are also a few added candles in the tutorial level to encourage players to try out this mechanic.

Another update concerns the splash screen. Originally, it used GameMaker Studio 2’s built-in splash screen system, but after some investigation, I found that this might have caused crashes for some players when launching the game from Steam. Note that this might not still fix the issue, but hopefully it will.

Besides these updates, there are some smaller fixes listed below.

Have a whipping weekend! 


List of fixes:

Added the ability for the player to use the whip and sub-weapons while climbing a ladder

Changed the splash screen display method

Added notes about the new ladder mechanics in the tutorial area

Added a very minor vertical momentum when the player let's go of a ladder, improving ladder platforming slightly

Adjusted the collider size at the top of ladders

Fixed an issue where the player could grab a ladder when pressing down while already on solid ground, which could cause the player to get stuck

Fixed a sub-weapon loading issue where the last equipped sub-weapon was not saved when saving and loading a game

Removed V-Sync, as it might also cause crashes for some users when launching the game

Adjusted the collider size of the Armless Maiden’s projectiles

Added minor visual hints in Challenge Level 1 to make some secrets slightly easier to find, as players were having trouble discovering them

Some small graphical adjustments  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694425/74881dddd7a3ecdb4a2c13c717f3045436869f35.png"]

notes.title: Demo version 0.2.4.4
notes.notes:
List of changes:  
[p align="start"]- Adjusted ladders so that they're easier to grab while in mid-air (even when playing with a thumbstick)
[p align="start"]- NPCs now have an indicator when they have items for sale
[p align="start"]- Candles have a slight chance of dropping healing items (small beetroot)
[p align="start"]- Enemy and boss damage balancing
[p align="start"]- Balance changes to level 2
[p align="start"]- Enemies now stop attacking after the player dies, to prevent annoying audio looping
[p align="start"]- Screen shake can now be turned off in the settings menu
[p align="start"]- Some music looping/rattling fixes
